name: FIREWATCH
concept: A zero-click autonomous campaign engine that, from a single launch, surveys the allowlisted lab surface, assays candidate attack spines (request-smuggling, LFI log-poison RCE, JWT confusion, SSRF pivot) with low-cost canaries, executes the chosen spine to RCE, plants marker-tagged persistence, beacons back, and writes the report itself.
novelty_angle: self-driving campaign orchestrator treating spine-selection as live adversarial optimization
scope_gate: Canonicalizing allowlist resolver under-specified vs cohort standard; must inherit resolver + markers.
